claims.quote: Type locality is 'Java, Indonesia', and this species is known only from the Ciantern, Cidurian, Cikeas, Ciliwung, Cimanuk, Cisokan, and Citarum River systems in western Java.
It has been confused in the past with H. gracilis, H. velox and H. bongan, and the population once thought to inhabit northwestern Peninsular Malaysia has been described as H. divaricatus.
